
## Summary

**Establish copy and library-panel governance** (residual after DUX5)

Copy and layout can drift across seven dashboards.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P3**
- Wave: **V4**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P3-01`
- DUX code: `DUX6-30`

## Scope

Dashboard system and provisioning repository.

Screenshot groups: docs/system

## Concrete change

Publish interface-layer copy dictionary, status-card template, empty-state component, table conventions and title rules. Do not move business verdict logic into Grafana.

## Expected effect

Future changes remain consistent and architecture-compliant.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every shared pattern has an owner, version and screenshot fixture; logic owner is documented outside Grafana.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Docs-as-code and Grafana library panels.

## Risk

Governance overhead if made too granular.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7132 DUX5-30 closed — residual: library-panel extraction deferred

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card
